story: Lily is at home with her grandmother. They look at a calendar to check a special date. Lily wants some new pants for school. She sees a flower on the wall and thinks about her student life.
title: A Special Day
setting: A cozy living room in a house.

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: A young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt.

characters.name: Grandmother
characters.look: An old woman with grey hair and glasses.

sentences.en: Lily is at home with her grandmother.
sentences.zh: 莉莉和她的祖母在一起。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt, sits with Grandmother, an old woman with grey hair and glasses, in a living room.

sentences.en: They look at the date on the calendar.
sentences.zh: 她们看着日历上的日期。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily and Grandmother look at a large paper calendar on the table.

sentences.en: The next holiday is very soon.
sentences.zh: 下一个假期很快就要到了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandmother points to a square on the calendar.

sentences.en: Lily wants some new blue pants.
sentences.zh: 莉莉想要一些新的蓝色裤子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily points to a pair of blue pants in a magazine.

sentences.en: Which pair does she like more?
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily looks at two different pairs of blue pants in a magazine.

sentences.en: A small flower is on the wall.
sentences.scene_prompt: A small colorful flower decoration hangs on the white living room wall.

sentences.en: The student needs a clean toilet.
sentences.zh: 这个学生需要一个干净的厕所。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a student, looks at a small door leading to a clean bathroom.

sentences.en: She moves her arm to point.
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily moves her arm to point at the magazine on the table.
